## Contract checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes or updates an executable contract.
- [ ] Generated files were rebuilt through documented commands.
- [ ] English documentation and its `.zh-CN.md` mirror are synchronized.
- [ ] UI changes were checked in both System 6 and Liquid Glass.
- [ ] No credential, private document, machine-local path, or deployment detail is included.
- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and followed the Code of Conduct.
